calls.title: GrowthBook <>Appcast - Intro
calls.summary: The team is looking to transition from a manual A/B testing process to a more efficient and scalable experimentation platform using GrowthBook. Currently, they face challenges in running only one test per month due to engineering dependencies and manual data analysis. The intention is to increase testing frequency to eight per quarter, allowing product and data teams to conduct experiments independently. GrowthBook’s features, such as sticky bucketing and integrations with existing data infrastructure like AWS Athena, are key advantages. The platform offers flexible deployment options and a supportive partnership model, facilitating faster onboarding and reducing operational overhead. Moreover, the transparent pricing structure and open-source nature build trust and provide an escape route from vendor lock-in.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, GrowthBook, Experimentation, Data Warehouse, SDK Integration, Pricing Model

calls.title: Growthbook <> Appcast - Demo
calls.summary: The discussion focused on enhancing the current slow and manual experimentation process by leveraging GrowthBook's features. The team aims to conduct eight experiments per quarter with mutual exclusivity using the platform's namespace feature to prevent user overlap. Key points included integrating GrowthBook with Athena for custom metrics, implementing flexible feature flagging, and rolling out experiments progressively with safeguards. A free three to four-week trial was proposed to map initial tests to GrowthBook's capabilities while promoting a data-driven culture within Appcast. Participants highlighted the importance of transparency, AI-assisted experimentation, and ongoing support during the trial to build confidence in the platform.
calls.keywords: experiment setup, feature flagging, data warehouse, custom metrics, funnel analysis, trial/POC
